query: Amazon North America retail segment revenue Prime
normalized: amazon america north prime retail revenue segment

output.content:
Amazon’s **North America segment** generated **$426.3 billion of net sales in FY2025** (year ended December 31, 2025), up **10%** from **$387.5 billion in FY2024**; this is the company’s reported segment revenue and includes both retail and service activities in North America, rather than a standalone “retail-only” figure. [[1]] 

Amazon does **not disclose Prime revenue separately by the North America segment**. Prime membership fees are included in companywide service sales alongside other non-AWS subscriptions—such as digital video, audiobooks, music, and e-books—so Prime cannot be cleanly derived from the segment-sales disclosure. [[1]] 

For context, management attributed 2025 North America sales growth chiefly to higher unit sales, including third-party-seller sales, advertising, and subscription services, with fast-shipping offers cited as a driver of unit growth. [[2]]

sources.title: Amazon.com, Inc. - Amazon.com Announces Fourth Quarter Results
